cc:Work.dc:title: f05_prefill
cc:Work.dc:description: Three contrast rows appear in two independent deployment columns. Every root effect is retained at a rank ordered by prompt length, with a separate overall diamond and confidence interval. Packing favors the candidate for every root in the first two rows. At fixed P4, the A5000 train/279 point is an outlined diamond at a small negative reduction; it is not moved to zero. The two studies are not paired.
